title: Really useful!!
body: You can do literally anything with this app. You can set timers (to study, to relax, to read, to clean) or pomodoro method, you can set alarms and customise them (with things like “shake your phone five times” or “13+42” to make your brain wake up), you can keep track of how much water do you drink (the app will send you notifications to remind you to drink) and you can also keep track of your sleep. There are a lot of tips to study, clean, and things like this. There are motivation phrases, soundscapes, things to meditate and workout. Every day, when you open the app, a little sticker come in and ask you how do you feel and similar things. And you can obviously create a routine, and your phone will send you notifications when you have to do that things. It’s really easy to use, and perfect for persons who have ADHD or anxiety.

title: Could be better
body: The app is very useful and has a very cute UI, however two major UX flaws were a deal breaker for me that made me uninstall on the spot: 1. There’s no way to edit or delete a task you’ve set for a day that is not today, or if there is a way it is impossible to find which is also not good 2. There’s no way to edit the name and icon of a task you can choose from the pre-set list, even if you just want to change a word or the icon you have to completely make the task yourself from scratch, I’m not sure if it’s a bug or it was made like this I’m reporting these issues because you might be losing users or at the very least frustrating them when the fix would be so basic. Beside this, it has great potential!
